knownHosts.description: The host keys of the SFTP server, one line of `known_hosts` each, ALL the types of the server (`/etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub` with the host in front of each, or `ssh-keyscan <host>` without `-t`). Only the type and the key are used: they are given for the tunnel on the loopback of the nodes. The connection is refused when the key does not match.

sftpTlsGateway.description: The TLS SSH gateway of the SFTP server, reached by the tunnel of the nodes (SSH inside TLS, SNI `host`, the certificate is not checked).

host.description: The name of the server, it is the SNI.
